name: dp-it-normativa-grab
description: Downloads the Normattiva multivigente AKN export (nuova-ricerca, conferma, check-status, 303 location) of the given acts into <dir>/<actId>.zip with a sidecar <actId>.act.json for the convert class.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item {key, meta{kind, actId, ...}} fetch the act (normattiva: export zip plus .act.json; gu: print HTML plus .meta.json, one request per act paced at 1.5 s) and write the files atomically. Every item is tried; if any failed the run ends with an error (config_error if any failure is a config error, else transient_error) listing the failed keys. dryRun makes no request and writes nothing.

items.description: the acts to download, as reported by the detect step

dataGU.description: gu items: Gazzetta publication date YYYY-MM-DD

codiceRedazionale.description: gu items: codice redazionale, names the files

vigenza.description: gu items, optional: vigenza date YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

dryRun.description: plan only: no request, nothing written

allowedHosts.description: hosts the class may call (default api.normattiva.it, export.normattiva.it, www.gazzettaufficiale.it)
